## Description

Proposed quantum-inspired approach to statistical-arbitrage basket construction: Score relative mispricing across a basket of securities and construct hedged or market-neutral positions, subject to borrow, liquidity, and transaction-cost constraints. This is a concept-level interpretation of the title, not a complete trading specification: the exact model inputs/target, calibration, entry/exit or rebalance rules, and position sizing are not fully defined here.
